tools.name: preview_status
tools.title: Get preview status
tools.description: Report whether a collaborative browser tab is automation-capable, including its URL, title, visibility, loading state, viewport mode, and measured CSS-pixel size. Pass tabId to inspect a specific tab; omit it to use this agent session's current tab.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

tools.name: preview_open
tools.title: Open browser preview
tools.description: Initialize a collaborative browser tab and open its thread-bound inline preview by default. Set open=false for background-only automation. Pass tabId to reuse a specific existing tab, set reuseExistingTab=false to create another tab, or omit both to use this agent session's current tab.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

url.description: Optional initial page URL. Absolute http(s) URL or a schemeless host such as t3.chat or localhost:5173. Schemeless public hosts use https; loopback hosts use http. Omit to open a blank tab.

anyOf.description: Whether to open the thread-bound inline preview for the human. Defaults to true; set false for background-only automation.
Deprecated alias for open. Whether to reveal the thread-bound inline preview to the human.
Reuse tabId when supplied, otherwise this agent session's current tab. Defaults to true; set false to create a new tab.

tools.name: preview_navigate
tools.title: Navigate browser preview
tools.description: Navigate a collaborative browser tab. Pass tabId to target a specific tab, plus {url:'https://t3.chat'} for a website or {target:{kind:'environment-port',port:5173}} for a dev server. Exactly one of url or target is required.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

url.description: Website URL. Absolute http(s) URL or a schemeless host such as t3.chat or localhost:5173. Schemeless public hosts use https; loopback hosts use http. Use this for public pages and directly reachable URLs.
Direct website URL. Absolute http(s) URL or a schemeless host such as t3.chat or localhost:5173. Schemeless public hosts use https; loopback hosts use http.

kind.description: Selects a dev-server port relative to the current execution environment.

port.description: Dev-server TCP port inside the current environment.

anyOf.description: Dev-server protocol. Defaults to http.
Optional path, query, and fragment, for example /settings?tab=account.
Environment-relative target. Prefer {kind:'environment-port',port:5173} for a dev server in the current environment.

target.description: Environment-relative target. Prefer {kind:'environment-port',port:5173} for a dev server in the current environment.

anyOf.description: Readiness milestone before returning. 'load' waits for loading to stop (default), 'domContentLoaded' waits for an interactive document, and 'none' returns immediately.

readiness.description: Readiness milestone before returning. 'load' is the default; use 'none' only when a later wait call will verify the page.

anyOf.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

tools.name: preview_resize
tools.title: Resize browser viewport
tools.description: Resize a collaborative browser tab, optionally selected by tabId. Use {mode:'fill'}, {mode:'freeform',width:1024,height:768}, or {mode:'preset',preset:'iphone-12-pro',orientation:'portrait'}. This changes CSS layout breakpoints without changing the desktop browser user agent.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

mode.description: Viewport mode: fill follows the preview panel, freeform uses exact independently resizable dimensions, and preset uses a named device size.

anyOf.description: Named viewport from Chrome DevTools' standard device catalog.

preset.description: Named device size. Required only when mode is preset.

anyOf.description: Freeform viewport width in CSS pixels. Required only in freeform mode.

width.description: Freeform viewport width in CSS pixels. Required only in freeform mode.

anyOf.description: Freeform viewport height in CSS pixels. Required only in freeform mode.

height.description: Freeform viewport height in CSS pixels. Required only in freeform mode.

anyOf.description: Orientation for a fixed device preset. Defaults to the preset's native orientation.

orientation.description: Orientation for a named device preset. It is not accepted in fill or freeform mode.

anyOf.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

tools.name: preview_set_appearance
tools.title: Set preview appearance
tools.description: Emulate prefers-color-scheme in a collaborative browser tab, optionally selected by tabId. Use {colorScheme:'dark'} or {colorScheme:'light'} to preview the page in that appearance, and {colorScheme:'system'} to clear the override and follow the OS appearance.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

colorScheme.description: Emulated prefers-color-scheme for the page: light, dark, or system to follow the OS appearance.

inputSchema.description: Emulates prefers-color-scheme in the active browser tab without changing the OS or app theme.

tools.name: preview_click
tools.title: Click preview page
tools.description: Click exactly one target in the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted. Prefer a Playwright locator; selector accepts legacy CSS; x and y must be supplied together.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector such as button[type='submit']. Prefer locator for resilient role/text targeting.

locator.description: Playwright selector, preferably role/text based, for example role=button[name='Send'] or text=Continue. Use snapshot first to inspect the page.

anyOf.description: Viewport-relative X coordinate in CSS pixels. Must be paired with y.
Viewport-relative Y coordinate in CSS pixels. Must be paired with x.
Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

tools.name: preview_type
tools.title: Type into preview page
tools.description: Insert literal text into one input in the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted. Prefer a Playwright locator; set clear=true to replace existing text.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector for the input. Prefer locator.

locator.description: Playwright selector for the input, for example role=textbox[name='Message'] or textarea[placeholder*='Message'].

anyOf.description: Clear the existing input value before inserting text. Defaults to false.
Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

tools.name: preview_press
tools.title: Press key in preview page
tools.description: Press one keyboard key in the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted. Examples: {key:'Enter'}, {key:'Escape'}, or {key:'a',modifiers:['Meta']}.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

key.description: Keyboard key name such as Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, Backspace, or a single character.

allOf.description: Keyboard key name such as Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, Backspace, or a single character.

anyOf.description: Modifier keys held while pressing key.

inputSchema.description: Presses one keyboard key in the active browser tab.

tools.name: preview_scroll
tools.title: Scroll preview page
tools.description: Scroll the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted. Positive deltaY scrolls down and positive deltaX scrolls right; a locator/selector targets a container.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

anyOf.description: Horizontal scroll delta in CSS pixels. Positive scrolls right. Defaults to 0.
Vertical scroll delta in CSS pixels. Positive scrolls down. Defaults to 0.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector for a scrollable container. Omit to scroll the viewport.

locator.description: Playwright selector for a scrollable container. Omit to scroll the viewport.

tools.name: preview_evaluate
tools.title: Evaluate JavaScript in preview
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted. Returns {value} with a serializable result up to 64 KB; the expression may mutate page state.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

expression.description: JavaScript expression evaluated in the page's main frame, for example document.title or (() => ({href: location.href}))().

allOf.description: JavaScript expression evaluated in the page's main frame, for example document.title or (() => ({href: location.href}))().

anyOf.description: Await a returned Promise. Defaults to true.
Serialize and return the value instead of a remote object reference. Defaults to true.

inputSchema.description: Evaluates JavaScript in the page. Prefer snapshot and semantic actions; use evaluate for inspection or unsupported interactions.

tools.name: preview_wait_for
tools.title: Wait for preview page condition
tools.description: Wait in the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted, until all supplied locator, selector, text, and URL conditions match.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector that must match an element. Prefer locator.

locator.description: Playwright selector that must match an element, for example role=button[name='Send'].

text.description: Case-sensitive substring that must appear in visible document text.

urlIncludes.description: Substring that must appear in the current absolute URL.

anyOf.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

tools.name: preview_recording_start
tools.title: Start browser recording
tools.description: Start recording the collaborative browser tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

tools.name: preview_recording_stop
tools.title: Stop browser recording
tools.description: Stop recording the collaborative browser tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted, and transfer the compressed recording once (up to 50 MiB) to an evidence file readable in this agent's environment. Returns its environment-local path after transfer succeeds.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

tools.name: preview_snapshot
tools.title: Inspect browser page
tools.description: Inspect a page before interacting. Pass tabId to inspect a specific tab; omit it to use this agent session's current tab. Returns page state, semantic elements, diagnostics, action history, and a PNG screenshot. The text is capped near 20 KB and lists what it omitted; use preview_evaluate to read more. Set includeImage=false for text-only output with the same page metadata. Set save=true to also write the PNG to disk and get screenshotPath back; with includeImage=false, save=true returns only the url and screenshotPath. Embed that path in your reply as ![alt](screenshotPath) so the user sees it. This is the only way to show the user a screenshot; the image in the tool result is not saved anywhere.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

anyOf.description: Include the PNG image in the tool response. Defaults to true. Set false for text-only output.
Write the screenshot PNG to disk and return its absolute path as screenshotPath. With includeImage=false, return only the url and screenshotPath. Defaults to false.

tools.name: link_pull_request
tools.title: Link pull request to thread
tools.description: Register every pull request you open for this thread, including each layer of a stack, right after creating it. Links a pull request to this thread so T3 Code tracks it, shows its status beside the thread, and settles the thread when it merges. Pass the URL, or repository plus number. Linking an already-linked pull request succeeds with alreadyLinked=true.

anyOf.description: Pull request number. Required with repository when url is omitted.

alreadyLinked.description: True when the pull request was linked to this thread before the call.

tools.name: unlink_pull_request
tools.title: Unlink pull request from thread
tools.description: Remove a pull request link from this thread, for example after closing a pull request you opened by mistake. Pass the URL, or repository plus number. Unlinking a pull request that is not linked succeeds with wasLinked=false.

anyOf.description: Pull request number. Required with repository when url is omitted.

wasLinked.description: False when the pull request was not linked to this thread to begin with.

tools.name: list_thread_pull_requests
tools.title: List thread pull requests
tools.description: List the pull requests linked to this thread with their last known host state, and how they chain into stacks (bottom to top). Register every pull request you open for this thread, including each layer of a stack, right after creating it.

tools.name: device_list
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: List iOS Simulators and Android Emulators on this environment's device hosts, which platforms each host can run, and which devices are already open in this thread's Device panel. Call this before device_open when you do not know a device id.

anyOf.description: Limit to one device host. Defaults to all hosts.

tools.name: device_open
tools.title: Open device
tools.description: Open a simulator or emulator for this thread: boots it if needed, starts its live stream, and shows it in the user's Device panel so they can watch. Returns the agent-device CLI invocation pinned to the device; drive the device with that CLI afterwards.

anyOf.description: Required when deviceId is omitted and both platforms are available.

inputSchema.description: Boots the device if needed, starts its live stream, and opens the Device panel so the user can watch. Returns how to drive it with the agent-device CLI.

tools.name: device_close
tools.title: Close device
tools.description: Remove a device from this thread's Device panel. Pass shutdown=true to also power the simulator or emulator off.

anyOf.description: Also power the simulator or emulator off. Defaults to false.

tools.name: device_screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot device
tools.description: Capture the current screen of an open device as a PNG image. Use it to see what the user sees; for taps and text use the agent-device CLI.
